# Sportbex

> > Sportbex provides real-time sports data APIs and white-label betting platform solutions for cricket, motorsport, tennis, soccer, horse racing, and more.

Sportbex offers comprehensive REST APIs delivering live scores, odds, and statistics across major sports including Formula 1, MotoGP, NASCAR, ICC cricket tournaments, and global racing events. The platform also provides white-label casino and sportsbook solutions for operators looking to launch betting platforms in 2025-2026.
